_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Logistics Composite Model Analysis Toolkit (LCOM ATK) Study Input Plan
summary: The LCOM ATK Study Input Plan describes the inputs required to construct an LCOM study for a program office, including ground rules, assumptions, data sources, reliabilities, resource requirements, task networks, and operational flows.
use_relationship:
The Logistics Composite Model Analysis Toolkit (LCOM ATK) Study Input Report shall describe the inputs required to construct an LCOM study for a program office, detailing all ground rules and assumptions, data sources, component reliabilities, resource requirements, maintenance task networks, and flight line operational flows.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work described in the contract.
b. This DID is used in conjunction with DI-PSSS-82054, Logistics Composite Model Analysis Toolkit (LCOM ATK) Study.
(Copies of this document are available online at http://quicksearch.dla.mil.)
